notes: Manufacturer spec sheet (aidaimagingkorea.com PDF, same content as aidaimaging.com/ptz-ndi-x20/) lists Output as "HD-SDI/3G-SDI, HDMI, RTSP/RTMP/NDI|HX2, USB 3.0 & 2.0", Camera Control as "RS-232C IN & OUT, RJ-45", and Power as "12VDC (+9 to +15VDC), PoE+ (IEEE802.3at)". Exact rear-panel port labels were confirmed via AIDA's combined PTZ user manual (AIDA-IPNDI-PTZ-manual-V3.1.pdf, hosted at aidaimaging.com), whose "Camera Interface PTZ-X12, X20" diagram explicitly covers the PTZ-NDI-X20 and numbers: RS-232 Control Input, RS-232 Control Output, HDMI Output, 3.5mm Unbalanced Passive Line-in port, 3G-SDI Output, USB Port, RJ-45 Port, DC12V Plug-in port. That manual's spec table states "Video Interface: HDMI (V1.4), 3G-SDI, RJ-45, USB 3.0" confirming HDMI 1.4 and 3G-SDI (BNC) grades. The single USB port is USB 3.0 (also usable as USB 2.0/UVC 1.1 for legacy compatibility) - modeled as one bidirectional usb-5g port. RJ-45 carries Gigabit Ethernet (1000M per spec) plus PoE+ (IEEE802.3at) for combined power+data, VISCA-over-IP, and NDI|HX2 - graded eth-1g. RS-232 IN/OUT exact physical connector style (e.g. mini-DIN vs 3-pin terminal) was not visible in the diagrams reviewed; mapped to generic rs232 as the closest allowed match. The 3.5mm port is an unbalanced passive line-in for embedding audio (not mic-level), so no grade applies - modeled as ts-6.35's small-jack cousin trs-3.5 (closest connector id; likely mono/unbalanced but list has no distinct mono variant). Desktop PTZ camera, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Manufacturer spec PDFs disagree slightly on overall dimensions (155x160x170mm vs 220x173x190mm in different AIDA documents) but this does not affect the port findings above.
